tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App ground behind panels: GitHub Primer inset grey, so cards read as raised. shadcn --background.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The graph canvas only. Same depth as the ground so the canvas reads as a well inside its card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Triage card, trace panel, side panels. shadcn --card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Node hover cards, menus, command palette. shadcn --popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Code and Cypher blocks, table header rows, empty states. shadcn --muted.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons (Dry run, Copy Cypher). shadcn --secondary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected row surface. shadcn --accent. Not the brand colour: amber is primary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and rows. Decorative, so below 3:1 by design.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes). 3:1 or more on card and background in both themes. shadcn --input.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card, popover and muted. shadcn --foreground.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. shadcn --card-foreground.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover. shadcn --popover-foreground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a secondary button. shadcn --secondary-foreground.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on the hover surface. shadcn --accent-foreground.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, tool durations, placeholder text. 5.4:1 or more on background, card and muted in both themes. shadcn --muted-foreground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Keystone amber. The one primary action per view (Run triage, Apply to sandbox) as a FILL. In light it is too pale for text: use evidence for amber text. shadcn --primary.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill. 6.6:1 or more in both themes. shadcn --primary-foreground.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Evidence: highlighted graph paths, citation chips, the cited span. Also amber text on background, card and evidence-soft (5.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: evidence-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a cited sentence or a selected citation chip. Text on it: foreground or evidence.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour. 5.4:1 or more on every surface. shadcn --ring.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success: action applied, backtest pass. Always beside a word or a check icon. Text on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Risk and failure: bus-factor flags, failed tool calls, Reject. Always beside a word or icon. shadcn --destructive.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Alias used by the graph and triage card for bus-factor and escalation flags.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links out to GitHub (issues, PRs, profiles) and the selected run marker. Never amber. 4.5:1 or more on background and card.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Warnings that are not failures: fallback runs, partial results, the bus-factor meter. Always beside an icon or word.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Closed issues and merged PRs, as on GitHub.

tokens.name: node-person
tokens.usage: Person nodes (circle). Also a login's text colour in the trace.

tokens.name: node-team
tokens.usage: Team nodes (hexagon).

tokens.name: node-code
tokens.usage: Repo, Module and File nodes (rounded square). Stone: code is the structure everything rests on.

tokens.name: node-issue
tokens.usage: Issue nodes (ring). Follows GitHub's open-issue green so maintainers read it instantly.

tokens.name: node-pr
tokens.usage: PR nodes (filled circle with a notch). Follows GitHub's PR purple.

tokens.name: node-knowledge
tokens.usage: Doc, Chunk and Decision nodes (diamond).

tokens.name: node-memory
tokens.usage: AgentRun, Feedback and Rule nodes (dashed ring). Bone: the agent's own notes, quieter than the org's data.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Graph edges at rest, on canvas.

tokens.name: edge-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of the hovered node's neighbourhood. 3:1 or more on canvas.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (the graph's own result). shadcn --chart-1.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Baseline series (CODEOWNERS only). shadcn --chart-2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: shadcn --chart-3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: shadcn --chart-4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: shadcn --chart-5.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Instrument Sans from Google Fonts, weights 400, 500 and 600. A dense tool: 14px body.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state question and the landing headline only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Touched src/serializers in 9 merged PRs since March.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The decision inside a sentence; table row names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels over panels and legend groups. Always uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a row; chart axis labels.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts, weights 400 and 500. Anything copied out of Keystone is mono.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Cypher blocks in the trace panel and README.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Logins, paths, issue numbers, node labels on the canvas, tool names.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The one headline number (backtest hit rate). Tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Panels pad space-4; rows pad space-2 by space-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; vertical row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal row padding; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters at desktop width.

radius.note: Cut stone: small, firm corners. Round only for nodes and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, citation chips, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, trace rows. shadcn --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and person nodes.

shadow.note: Flat panels; only floating things cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Node hover cards, menus, the command palette.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-colour gap, then 2px of solid ring colour.

graph.note: Canvas geometry for react-force-graph or Cytoscape.

tokens.name: node-size-sm
tokens.usage: Radius of File and Chunk nodes.

tokens.name: node-size-md
tokens.usage: Radius of Person, Issue, PR, Decision and memory nodes.

tokens.name: node-size-lg
tokens.usage: Radius of Team, Repo and Module nodes, and the issue under triage.

tokens.name: edge-width
tokens.usage: Edges at rest.

tokens.name: edge-width-evidence
tokens.usage: Edges on a highlighted evidence path.

opacity.note: How the canvas recedes when a path is highlighted.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Nodes and edges outside the highlighted evidence path.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Nodes outside a hovered node's neighbourhood.
